added: Scoped Permissions controls for workspace, project and assessment grants, pending invitations, role changes, revocation and ownership transfer.
changed: Permission actions refresh server-owned roster and role state in place while keeping their outcome, receipt and trace visible.
fixed: Successful permission actions no longer erase their confirmation through a blank-model route reload; transfer receipts resolve to grant rows.
security: Danger actions retain preview/confirm with identical parameters; scopes remain explicit with no permission inheritance. Post-action access refusal hides stale controls while retaining the completed action receipt.
